title: Efficient INT8 Inference of Small NLP Models on Server CPUs with PyTorch Native Stack
abstract: arXiv:2608.18182v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Small NLP models, especially BERT-family encoders, remain important in industrial workloads such as classification, ranking, and retrieval even in the era of large language models. On server CPUs, INT8 quantization offers an attractive latency-throughput-cost trade-off, but users increasingly expect such acceleration to be available directly in the native PyTorch stack. We integrate SmoothQuant into TorchAO and optimize the resulting inference path for Intel Xeon CPUs through graph-level fusion in TorchInductor and efficient INT8 GEMM kernel selection across oneDNN-, AVX512_VNNI-, and AMX-based implementations. Across BERT, DistilBERT, and XLM-RoBERTa benchmarks, the approach delivers up to 5.8x end-to-end throughput speedup with negligible---and in some cases no measurable---accuracy loss relative to the FP32 baseline. We also validated our work by detailed performance analysis with roofline models. The implementation has been upstreame

translated_title: 在服务器CPU上使用PyTorch原生栈实现小规模NLP模型的高效INT8推理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.18182v1 公告类型：新 摘要：小规模NLP模型，尤其是BERT系列的编码器，即使在大型语言模型时代，在分类、排序和检索等工业工作负载中仍然非常重要。在服务器CPU上，INT8量化提供了有吸引力的延迟-吞吐量-成本权衡，但用户越来越期望这种加速能直接在原生PyTorch栈中使用。我们将SmoothQuant集成到TorchAO中，并通过TorchInductor中的图级融合以及基于oneDNN、AVX512_VNNI和AMX实现的高效INT8 GEMM内核选择，优化了针对Intel Xeon CPU的推理路径。在BERT、DistilBERT和XLM-RoBERTa基准测试中，该方法实现了高达5.8倍的端到端吞吐量加速，且相对于FP32基线，精度损失可忽略不计（在某些情况下甚至没有可测量的损失）。我们还通过使用roofline模型的详细性能分析验证了我们的工作。该实现已上游集成。
tldr: 本文通过将SmoothQuant集成到TorchAO并优化Intel Xeon CPU上的图融合和INT8内核选择，实现了小规模NLP模型高达5.8倍的推理加速，且精度损失极小或为零。
en_tdlr: This paper integrates SmoothQuant into TorchAO and optimizes graph fusion and INT8 kernel selection on Intel Xeon CPUs, achieving up to 5.8x inference speedup for small NLP models with negligible or no accuracy loss.
